question: In basketball, when a referee throws the ball up into the center circle to determine which team receives the ball it is called a _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jump Ball**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **Jump Ball** is a method used to start or resume play in basketball.
 
• It involves the referee throwing the ball up into the air between two opposing players who jump to tap the ball to their teammates.
